associations.rationale: The declaration constructs a basis of CliffAlg B indexed by finite subsets from an orthogonal basis of V, supporting the subset-indexed Clifford basis claim, but the displayed type does not identify its basis vectors as the ordered monomials.
The theorem directly states that for a basis of V indexed by Fin N, the complex finrank of CliffAlg B is 2^N.
The theorem directly states that, for an orthogonal basis, the span of the range of the subset-indexed family e is the whole Clifford algebra, matching the spanning part of the source claim.
